title: Unify Board Element Styling States
description: Make board styling consistent across node, edge, handle, and wire. Extend element style support to cover original, neutral, hovered, selected, highlighted, disabled. Add a shared style prop through the board element contract and use it consistently across features. Add a window option for original style, default false, so imported elements such as SVGs can remain unmodified when requested. Validate through focused tests/builds.
summary: Removed minimap/overview LOD guard that blocked discrete pick/select via resolve_hit_world; hover was already enabled through resolve_hover_world. Bounded group drag on minimap/overview is unchanged (try_begin_bounded_selection_drag_at when pointer misses a discrete hit inside the padded selection union). Updated host tests for discrete hits at minimap/compact and bounded-drag fixtures (clear edges/handles on gap probes). Validation: cargo test -p elements_board --lib — 74 passed.
